controls: One engine, original FI dense prefill/XQA and one common native E0 graph/buffer set; all independent/newmask histories frozen before decode; every install charged.
gate: Root decides whether to launch only after short graph qualification and independent same-E0 mechanism gate; no automatic launch.
limitations: No novel algorithm; classical coverage system/quality baseline is mandatory before superiority claims.
Pooled-score epsilon does not bound decode mass/O/LSE or task error.
Full E0 already changed a development answer, so output differences cannot all be attributed to deleting KV.
Only E0 graphs retained; historical grids retained E0+union. Graph/capture memory change is not algorithm gain.
Keep one-time selector/D2H/CPU/frozen variants, per-arm history install, anchor, generation, and audit export separate; no full-cache release.
